name: OPC UA
description: Browse the OPC UA address space of PLCs and servers, then read and write node values with data type aware decoding.
releaseNotes: 0.2.0: plugin id is now io.github.bobocha214.opcua and the licence is MIT -- connections from 0.1.0 are not migrated, re-add them once. New icons; three-column workbench with draggable splitters; Variable points can be dragged onto the board; writes wait for the session handshake, resolve the node DataType server-side, report the OPC UA status code on failure and read the value back.

zh-CN.description: 浏览 PLC 和 OPC UA 服务器的地址空间，按数据类型读取并写入节点值。
